warnings: Tags are printed 'C1F' / 'C2F' = column mark + footing F (one footing type, detail F on แผ่นที่ 3: 1.00 x 1.00, 6 hollow hexagonal piles). C1F sits under the T1 trusses (A2, A3, D2, D3); C2F at the four corners and on the gable walls (B1, C1, B4, C4). Rows B/C have no column on grids 2-3 — the 10.00 m span is a steel truss.
Ground beams are all printed 'G' (detail G 0.15 x 0.35 on แผ่นที่ 3); they run only round the perimeter (rows A, D and grids 1, 4) — 12 grid-to-grid segments.

The floor is one slab-on-grade panel with no mark — element_id null, name in element_name_assigned. The ทางเท้า ค.ส.ล. walkway (0.08 m, Ø6 @0.25 #) is printed only on the architectural แปลนพื้น (view1, not extracted).
Grid labels 1-4 / A-D are assigned (no bubbles printed) — see the grid master.
